test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cushions are quilts.

All pillows are quilts.

All quilts are beds.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cushions are beds.

II. Some pillows are beds.

III. Some cushions are pillows.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3fabb45b83c9a82090be069581d80251a2b2790168a77818696386dfcd94f3e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cushions are beds → Follow (As all cushions are quilts and all quilts are beds. As whole cushions comes in quilts which whole comes in beds, therefore it is true.)

II. Some pillows are beds → Follow (As all pillows are quilts and all quilts are beds. As whole pillows comes in quilts which whole comes in beds, therefore it is true.)

III. Some cushions are pillows → Does not follow (As all cushions are quilts and all pillows are quilts. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
